# Property Systems Lab — Full Content Reference

## Business Summary

Property Systems Lab is an automation and operations support company built specifically for property management and vacation rental businesses. We help teams reduce manual admin work, improve follow-up consistency, connect disconnected systems, and scale operations without unnecessary complexity.

We combine workflow automation, CRM optimization, and trained virtual assistant support — so our clients get both the systems and the human support to run them.

## The Problems We Solve

Property management teams commonly struggle with:

- Missed owner leads because there is no consistent follow-up process
- Manual follow-up emails and messages that should be automated
- Disconnected systems (PMS, CRM, spreadsheets, communication tools) that don't sync
- Slow maintenance reporting — updates buried in emails, owners left waiting
- Repetitive admin tasks like lease renewals, document collection, and status updates
- Overloaded internal teams buried in operational tasks that don't require their expertise
- Messy CRM pipelines where deals, leads, and owner relationships are scattered
- Time-consuming document workflows for leases, owner agreements, and recurring paperwork

## Our Services

### 1. Automation & AI Systems
We build workflows that reduce repetitive work, improve visibility, and keep teams moving. From lead follow-up sequences to maintenance notifications, we connect systems and remove the manual steps in between — including custom API development and cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Primary tools: Zapier, n8n, custom APIs, Azure, GCP, trigger-based workflows.

### 2. CRM & Pipeline Optimization
We clean up and organize sales, leasing, owner, and maintenance pipelines so teams always know what needs attention and nothing gets missed. Primary platform: HubSpot.

### 3. Virtual Assistant Support
Trained support for manual tasks that still need human judgment and follow-through — owner communications, inbox management, data entry, document tracking, and recurring operational tasks.

### 4. Reporting & Operations Dashboards
We create reports and summaries that help managers understand what needs attention — maintenance status, owner performance, leasing activity, and team workload — without digging through multiple systems. Primary tool: Google Sheets with automated data feeds.

### 5. Document & Communication Workflows
We streamline recurring documents, follow-ups, email and SMS sequences, and internal handoffs so teams spend less time on paperwork and more time on properties. Tools: PandaDoc, email/SMS automation.

## Our Process

1. **Review your current workflows** — structured review of how the team handles leads, maintenance, owner communications, documents, and internal handoffs to identify where time is being lost.
2. **Identify what to automate and what to delegate** — not everything should be automated. We help decide what belongs in a workflow, what still needs a human, and what the right tools and processes are.
3. **Build the systems and train the support process** — build and configure automations, set up CRM pipelines and reporting, and establish support processes for the VA team.
4. **Provide ongoing automation and VA operations support** — monitor, maintain, and improve workflows over time, handling updates, catching issues, and adding new automations as the operation grows.

## Why Property Systems Lab

- We understand property management operations specifically — the workflows, tools, and challenges unique to LTR and STR businesses
- We combine systems, automation, and human support — most agencies only offer one
- We help teams scale without unnecessary complexity — we focus on the simplest system that solves the problem
- We support both long-term and short-term rental operations
- We focus on practical workflows that teams can realistically manage and maintain

## Pricing

All pricing depends on workload, number of systems, workflow complexity, and support hours required. Below are typical starting points:

| Service | Price |
|---|---|
| Workflow Audit | Starting at $750 (one-time) |
| Automation Implementation | Starting at $3,500 (one-time) |
| Automation + VA Operations Support | Starting at $2,500/month |
| Monthly Automation Support | Starting at $1,250/month |
| Custom Operations Support | Custom quote |

The Workflow Audit includes: current workflow documentation, systems and tools assessment, automation opportunity map, and a written recommendations report.

The Automation + VA Operations Support package is the most popular option. It includes automation monitoring and maintenance, VA operations support, workflow updates and improvements, reporting checks, and owner and admin task support.
